title: planner · Assign manager to inspect 4 sources on memory consolidation/forgetting
summary: Assign manager to inspect 4 sources on memory consolidation/forgetting, comparing dynamic strategies against static baselines at equal token budgets. Verify stopping rules and record limitations.
body:
1. Execute 4 targeted searches to find primary research/practitioner reports on 'agent memory consolidation forgetting dynamic pruning' and 'memory management token budget comparison'.
2. For each result, inspect the abstract and full text to verify claims about dynamic vs. static strategy superiority under equal token constraints.
3. Explicitly record exact search queries, URLs, authors, and dates. Document if sources compare against simple baselines (append-only Markdown, transcript top-k) or if comparisons are missing.
4. Synthesize findings: distinguish author claims from researcher inference. Note if dynamic strategies empirically outperform baselines or if evidence is inconclusive.
5. Adhere strictly to the 4-source limit. If 4 sources are inspected without meeting the comparison criteria, stop and report gaps. Do not exceed 2 plan reviews.
